environment.description: Laravel 10.x application running on PHP-FPM 8.2 in a Docker container with default capabilities (including CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_IPC_OWNER). Container runs as root with --privileged flag for legacy compatibility. Shared memory IPC namespace is shared with host (--ipc=host). No seccomp profile applied. PHP disable_functions is empty.
